items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: I started playing in his band

ctx.x: You might have. He died very early, and he might have been around when you first came into Rome, right around that time maybe he passed away. But I started playing in his band and as it turned out Tony was married to Jill’s sister and they lived in a duplex house and Jill lived on the other side. And when I was pulling into his house she came out on the porch and my world changed.
I remember some anecdote about you jumping over the organ or something at Birdland to defend her honor or something like that.
